action: Contact Nadia Osei, Robert Dunbar, and Priya Nair — the grant committee — to get a first report on small business grant applications. How many applications received? How many reviewed? Any approvals pending? Flag any patterns in who is applying and who isn't: if affected workers and businesses aren't finding the program, there's a marketing failure I need to fix immediately. Ask for a written summary by end of week.
